name: platform
description: The house rules the platform is written to: no script made from text, no shell but Bun's own, no raw HTML, and a vocabulary that stays runnable in a page.

rules.message: The page's policy allows no script made from text, and the schemas are built without one.
Bun.spawn is how this project runs what it runs.
The interface is written in components; a page is not assembled from strings.
The vocabulary runs in the browser, in Bun and in Node: it may not reach for the machine.
